sources.use: The behaviour specification this package implements. Nothing upstream was opened, decompiled or read to write this package.

The rights record the specification was written under, which clears code and behaviour and leaves names unresolved. This entry is almost entirely catalogue, so the unresolved names surface is why no identifier here is carried across and why aliases.json is empty.
The whole of what this package names of Ravel's own surface.
The shared library's non-mirrored recipe kind, its flag table and its crafting-remainder behaviour, consumed rather than reimplemented.
The tier and crop model, the three absence states, the ground behaviour and the recipe kinds this entry declares data against, consumed rather than reimplemented.
